scope: Read-only reconstruction of every recorded formal and compatibility-probe request; one new audit artifact only. No model invocation.
limits: Request hashes establish exact local request-body reconstruction against recorded digests; they are not packet captures.
The actual returned model field is qwen3.8-max; the provider does not expose an immutable weights revision in these responses.
Endpoint and timeout are verified from frozen code and runtime config; response bodies do not attest endpoint or timeout.
Nonempty reasoning_content plus positive reasoning_tokens verifies observable thinking output, not reasoning quality.
reasoning_tokens are a subset of completion_tokens and are not added again to total usage.
On calls, visible completion tokens are completion_tokens_details.text_tokens minus reasoning_tokens; recorded text_tokens equals completion_tokens in every call.
Reported latency is the sum of attempt durations; concurrent execution means it is not elapsed wall time.
All arms carry thinking_budget=4096; no observed on-mode call exceeded it. Off-mode responses omit reasoning-token detail.
Provider alias, scheduling, caching and hidden serving variation remain uncontrolled; randomized four-arm blocks reduce temporal imbalance.
Cost is token usage only; no currency cost is asserted.
This diagnostic replay is not new validation or a release qualification.
